dbSNP4Bioc

Build, cache, and query dbSNP VCF data as Parquet.

dbSNP4Bioc converts a single chromosome of an NCBI dbSNP VCF (as distributed: bgzipped and tabix-indexed) into a slim, sorted Parquet representation, caches it locally with BiocFileCache, and exposes the cached resource as a lazy dplyr/dbplyr table backed by duckdb, so that rsID and genomic-position lookups can be written with ordinary dplyr::filter() / dplyr::select() pipelines.

Setup

Point DBSNP_GCF_PATH at NCBI’s bgzipped, tabix-indexed dbSNP VCF (the .gz.tbi index must sit next to it):

export DBSNP_GCF_PATH=/path/to/GCF_000001405.40.gz

Build and cache a chromosome 

library(dbSNP4Bioc)

dbsnp_build_chrom("17", release = "b157", build = "GRCh38")
dbsnp_cached("b157", "GRCh38")   # see what is cached

This extracts chromosome 17 with tabix, keeps SNV records only (REF and every ALT a single A/C/G/T; one row per ALT allele), and writes two Parquet tables into the cache: by_pos (sorted by position) and by_rsid (sorted by rsID).

Query the cache with dplyr 

library(dplyr)

chr17 <- dbsnp_tbl("by_pos", chrom = "17", release = "b157", build = "GRCh38")

chr17 |>
  filter(pos >= 38077296, pos <= 38083854, n_alt == 1) |>
  select(pos, rs, ref, alt) |>
  collect()

dbsnp_disconnect(chr17)

A convenience wrapper is also provided for position-range lookups:

dbsnp_in_range("17", 38077296, 38083854, biallelic_only = TRUE,
               release = "b157", build = "GRCh38")

Reference

See inst/scripts/ for the original standalone scripts this package was built from, including notes on fetching the VCF from NCBI and an end-to-end example querying SNPs around a gene with TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38.knownGene.
